``` { .yaml .annotate linenums="1" }
services:
  bentopdf:
    image: ghcr.io/alam00000/bentopdf-simple:2.8.8
    environment:
      - TZ=America/Los_Angeles
    ports:
      - 8091:8080
    deploy:
      labels:  # (1)!
        - homepage.group=Tools
        - homepage.name=BentoPDF
        - homepage.icon=bentopdf.png
        - homepage.href=http://192.168.1.45:8091
        - homepage.description=PDF toolkit in the browser
      mode: replicated
      replicas: 1
```

1.  labels for the tile on the [homepage dashboard](../monitoring/homepage.md). they go under
    `deploy.labels` because homepage reads the swarm's service specs, and container labels aren't in them.
